tree/eusebius-of-caesarea.quote: They accused him over a cup used at the Lord's Supper, the church's meal of bread and wine, that had been broken.
tree/eusebius-of-caesarea.asks: Accused him of what, exactly, and why did a broken cup matter?

tree/eusebius-of-caesarea.quote: envy, like a dark cloud, stirs up quarrels in Egypt's churches
In 303 the emperors ordered the churches leveled and the Scriptures burned
tree/eusebius-of-caesarea.asks: Why did the emperors turn on the church?
